summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Progetto Oliveto (Pianificatore Cartografico Oliveto). Backend CRUD via pytest: 8/8 tests passed. Frontend UI via Playwright: map loads Google Hybrid tiles centered on San Pietro Vernotico, all TopBar controls present (btn-open-fields-drawer, input-search-location, btn-tile-layer-selector with 4 layer options google_hybrid/google_satellite/esri/osm, btn-open-side-panel), all 9 Toolbar buttons present in italiano, drawing perimeter with 4 map taps creates vertices and shows live-perimeter-info ('Punti: 4 ≈ 19.755 ha'), Chiudi/Salva closes polygon and opens SidePanel on Sesto tab, SidePanel exposes 5 tabs (Sesto/Orient./Ostacoli/Irrigaz./Risult.), Orientation panel shows 3 sub-tabs Manuale/Auto/Bordo with compass at 151° SE, ObstacleSheet opens with all 5 types (palo/fabbricato/pozzo/roccia/albero) and selecting one activates add-obstacle-point mode with obstacle-placement-hint, tap-to-place obstacle works, MeasureBar exposes Undo/Clear/Exit/UseAzimuth, FieldsDrawer exposes btn-create-field/duplicate/delete/edit-perimeter per field, EditPerimeterBar appears in edit mode with 'Salva'/'Annulla', floating btn-floating-params visible when active field is closed. Cleaned up 6 test-created fields.

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Non-blocking a11y warning; add DialogDescription or aria-describedby to Sheet/Dialog contents.

action_items: (low) Add DialogDescription/aria-describedby to Sheet/Dialog components (SidePanel, FieldsDrawer, ObstacleSheet) to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: all endpoints properly exclude MongoDB _id via projection. Good.
Planner.jsx is ~615 lines — approaching size threshold; consider splitting handlers (drawing/measure/edit/CRUD) into custom hooks (useDrawing, useMeasure, useEditPerimeter) for maintainability.

handleToolChange auto-creates a new field when user clicks 'Nuovo Campo' while an already-closed field is active — this is intentional but leads to fast accumulation of empty test fields during exploration; consider requiring an explicit create confirmation if the current field has 0 vertices.
seed_data_creation: None (test fields created during automation were deleted after run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Data-testid coverage is comprehensive. Correct obstacle-type testids are btn-obstacle-type-{palo|fabbricato|pozzo|roccia|albero} (not obstacle-type-*). Orientation panel is inside SidePanel — reach it via btn-open-side-panel or btn-optimize-azimuth. SidePanel opens on top of floating params so click Escape or the close button to interact with map afterwards.
